literal_meaning: ঝাড়া দিয়ে সরিয়ে ফেলা (to shake off and discard)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার মন থেকে সব দুঃখ ঝেড়ে ফেলল।
অলসতা ঝেড়ে ফেলে কাজ শুরু করো।
example_sentences_in_english: He shook off all the sadness from his mind.
Shake off your laziness and start working.
note: Commonly used to describe discarding unwanted habits or feelings, rooted in everyday physical actions like cleaning.
